name: Attack Shark X85Pro Tri-Mode Gasket Mechanical Keyboard Star Black
shortDescription: Attack Shark X85Pro Tri-Mode Gasket Mechanical Keyboard Star Black (75% Compact Layout / 0.85-inch TFT Smart Display & CNC Knob / Gasket Mounted / Tri-Mode 2.4GHz, Bluetooth & Wired / Hot-Swappable / PBT Keycaps
descriptionHtml:
Attack Shark X85Pro Tri-Mode Gasket Mechanical Keyboard Star Black (75% Compact Layout / 0.85-inch TFT Smart Display & CNC Knob / Gasket Mounted / Tri-Mode 2.4GHz, Bluetooth & Wired / Hot-Swappable / PBT Keycaps / RGB Backlight / 1-Year Official Agent Warranty)

Experience the pinnacle of custom keyboard performance with the Attack Shark X85Pro Tri-Mode Gasket Mechanical Keyboard in Star Black colorway, available at Turbo Computer Egypt with a 1-Year Official Agent Warranty (ضمان سنة من الوكيل). Designed in a versatile 75% ANSI layout (81 keys + 1 multi-function CNC knob), the X85Pro features a customizable 0.85-inch TFT smart display, an upgraded Gasket-Mount structure with 5-layer sound-absorbing padding, hot-swappable linear switches, durable PBT keycaps, and dynamic south-facing RGB illumination for the ultimate gaming and typing experience.
